stories.title: Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a strict, conversation-context-aware schema for tool scope including allowed tool names, permitted parameter shapes, and boundaries by context (e.g., Find Care vs Evaluate Care, consent state). Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic tool_models and the allowlist structure.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Core Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to validate each tool call against the scope contract, including allowlist membership, Pydantic parameter validation, and context-based restrictions (conversation mode and consent state) prior to execution.

stories.title: Integration with Tool Router and Agent Loop
stories.description: Integrate scope enforcement into the tool_router dispatch pipeline and ensure interception of all tool calls originating from the agent loop in main.py and facades, guaranteeing no bypass paths exist.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create comprehensive tests for valid and invalid tool calls, including out-of-scope tools, malformed inputs, context violations, and attempted bypass paths. Ensure enforcement consistency across all registered tools.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Response Handling and Observability
stories.description: Implement standardized rejection handling for out-of-scope tool calls including structured error codes, safe user-facing messaging, and debug logging with audit fields to trace scope violations without exposing sensitive data.
